title: Database, server, and owner
description: For each database return exactly three columns: database_name, hostname, owner_role. Include every database that has a defined server and owner role. Sort by hostname ASC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT d.name AS database_name,
       s.hostname,
       r.name AS owner_role
FROM databases AS d
hints: Join databases to servers by server_id and to db_roles by owner_role_id.
INNER JOIN is sufficient for this task.
solution_explanation: Two JOINs restore readable hostname and role name from foreign keys.
